text.style: fill: #111111; font: 700 13px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Early stopping: 250 steps of patience stops early and flattens the forecast

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Shaded = gap between patience 250 steps and patience 1,000 steps. Dotted lines = forecast origins. WMAPE = sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales; |bias| = |total forecast / total actual - 1|.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Example chosen by rule: largest error reduction from the shape of the forecast (both forecasts rescaled to actual sales) where patience 250 steps swings at most

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: 75% as much as patience 1,000 steps, among series selling at least the median weekly volume in history, with no run of 13+ zero weeks (off the shelf or out of

g.text: stock) and no run of 4+ zero weeks.
